scripts.lint: find module config public tasks -name '*.php' -print0 | xargs -0 -P 8 -n 1 php -d display_errors=stderr -l > /dev/null && for f in bin/console bin/migrate; do php -l $f > /dev/null || exit 1; done && for f in bin/*.sh bin/dev/review cron.sh; do bash -n $f || exit 1; done

scripts-descriptions.serve: Start the built-in PHP web server and serve the application.
scripts-descriptions.migrate-status: Show current DB version and pending migrations.
scripts-descriptions.migrate-dry-run: Preview pending migration statements without executing.
scripts-descriptions.housekeeping: Prune old api_logs and form_dump rows, and their body files.
scripts-descriptions.audits-unlinked: List v6 audits with no facility link (hidden from location-mapped users).
scripts-descriptions.cron: Run due scheduled tasks (crunz). Meant to be called every minute from the crontab.
scripts-descriptions.cron-list: List the scheduled tasks defined in tasks/.
scripts-descriptions.post-update: Post-deploy steps: apply migrations, then housekeeping. Each is allowed to fail without aborting the rest.
scripts-descriptions.refresh: Full update: rebase onto origin, reinstall dependencies, then run post-update.
scripts-descriptions.lint: Syntax-check every PHP file and shell script.
scripts-descriptions.qc: Validate composer.json, lint, run static analysis, and audit dependencies.
scripts-descriptions.phpstan: Static analysis at level 5. Errors already in phpstan-baseline.neon are not reported.
scripts-descriptions.phpstan:baseline: Regenerate phpstan-baseline.neon from the current code.
